title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.31125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch \Delta on the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing \Delta restores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. translated_title: Delta N-gram：向语言模型原生N-gram记忆的仅前向持续写入
translated_abstract: 我们之前的分析发现，模型原生的哈希N-gram表是持续更新对基础模型干扰最小的位置，但其写入需要反向传播，并且会改变预训练表。我们提出Delta N-gram，一种进入该表的仅前向写入路径。预训练表T^0永远不会被修改，证据被写入一个稀疏补丁Δ中其所寻址的行上：一个4.1M参数的写入器为每个（位置，哈希头）事件生成一个目标值和一个门控值，块平均的delta规则使每一行始终保持为其旧值与门控目标之间的凸组合。该写入器使用预训练目标在原始文本上离线训练；在使用时，写入仅需前向传播，清除Δ即可完全恢复原始模型。一个经过训练用于回答问题的0.6B参数原型模型在第二次写入后仍保留了16/16的事实；而在线梯度写入只能保留2-4/16。我们研究了两种写入器：一种是用仅基于T^0的模型编码证据的普通写入器，以及一种……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出Delta N-gram方法，通过冻结预训练N-gram表、将证据以仅前向传播的方式写入稀疏补丁Δ，实现无需反向传播的持续知识写入，清除补丁即可完全恢复原始模型，且事实保留效果远优于基于梯度的写入方法。
en_tdlr: Delta N-gram enables forward-only continual knowledge writing into a language model's native N-gram memory by freezing the pretrained table and writing evidence into a sparse patch Δ, fully restoring the base model upon clearing Δ while achieving far better fact retention than gradient-based writes.
